1. `allowPrivilegeEscalation != false` (Must be `false`)

3. `runAsNonRoot != true` (Must run as non-root)
4. `seccompProfile` (Must use `RuntimeDefault` or `Localhost`)

securityContext:

```

`[{"op": "add", "path": "/spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext", "value": { ... security context data ...}}]`

```json
[
  {
    "op": "add",
    "path": "/spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext",
    "value": {

      }
    }
  }
]
```
